principle: Keep the catalog small. The manager/model chooses the smallest relevant semantic capability from metadata; deterministic runtime resolves an exact contract id to exactly one pack and enforces execution boundaries without keyword-routing literary meaning.

packs.description: Blind reader experience, semantic hard-rule audit, independent production review, pairwise comparison, character integrity and semantic revision diagnosis.
packs.load_when: The task needs a natural reader signal, explicit semantic hard-rule compliance, character/repair diagnosis, candidate comparison, or an independent production-quality gate.

packs.description: Source-bound long-horizon narrative interpretation, reader-expectation interpretation, and derived-memory consolidation.
packs.load_when: The task needs long-form derived narrative state, live reader expectations, or compact rebuildable memory.

packs.description: Rights-safe craft mechanism analysis and blind evaluation for adaptive learning without automatic promotion authority.
packs.load_when: The task is semantic Corpus analysis or evaluation of a learning hypothesis/candidate.

packs.description: Agent-owned context selection and iterative search intent under deterministic visibility, authority, provenance, capability and resource guards.
packs.load_when: The task must decide what context is needed, reject irrelevant candidates, continue/reformulate search, stop searching, or plan evidence discovery.

packs.description: Goal- and knowledge-bounded character action simulation followed by scene-level collision/world-state resolution and causal event trajectory proposals.
packs.load_when: The task is pre-draft scene simulation, character agency simulation, or repair of a flat/forced scene through causal character/world interactions.

packs.description: Review-feedback interpretation, minimal writer-safe causal projection, and Editor repair planning. The Blind Reader is intentionally not duplicated here.
packs.load_when: The production loop must interpret explicit feedback, project private simulation into minimal writer-safe causal context, or turn Reader/Rule-Auditor findings into a bounded repair plan.

packs.description: Dynamic active-plan reconciliation, evidence-based relationship-memory reconciliation, and explicit narrative-commitment auditing for long-horizon coherence.
packs.load_when: The task must adapt a plan after causal emergence, reconcile conflicting long-lived relationship memories, or verify a candidate against explicit long-term commitments/facts.

packs.description: Causally divergent scenario exploration plus evidence-driven incumbent/challenger comparison that permits ties instead of assuming repeated revision improves a subjective artifact.
packs.load_when: The workflow needs materially distinct scenario forks before committing to a direction, or needs to verify that a repair candidate actually improves an incumbent without introducing regressions.
